name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: A horizontally scrolling row of slides with scroll snapping and previous/next buttons.

classes.name: carousel
classes.description: Row that holds the buttons and the content.

classes.name: carousel__content
classes.description: The scrolling track. Mark it data-carousel-target="content".

variables.name: --carousel-items
variables.description: How many slides are visible at once.

attributes.name: data-carousel-action
attributes.description: Wires events to the prev and next actions, e.g. "prev" on a button or "keydown.left->prev" on the root.

actions.name: prev
actions.description: Scrolls the content back by 100px; scroll snapping settles on the nearest slide.

examples.title: Multiple items
examples.description: Show several slides at once with --carousel-items.
